The claim that expectations have decoupled [E40] is better interpreted as a market anticipation of the "earnings growth accelerating" signal [E49], which is supported by strong sector tailwinds in both profit and sales growth [E56], [E57]. By fixating on trailing metrics, the bear fails to account for the consistent multi-year share price appreciation [E15], [E16], [E17] that indicates investors are increasingly recognizing the company's potential within a high-growth sector [E56], [E57].
